subject: How would you get fit measures for the mediation example?

messages.author: a71efe51e1c5a7c1
messages.subject: How would you get fit measures for the mediation example?
parts:
Hi,

For the example of mediation:

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/mediation.html

...how woud you get the fit measures out of it for the total model, since the model shows 0 df? In other words, if I run this example and then try fitMeasures(), I would get chisq of 0, or in summary(), I get 0 for Minimum Function Test Statistic (which is chisq, right?)

Thanks very much,

Josh Levy

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: How would you get fit measures for the mediation example?
parts: When you do not fix any parameters in the model (i.e., estimating both direct and indirect effects), the model-implied covariance matrix is the same as observed covariance matrix. That is, your model fits perfectly--that is why chisq = 0. However, it does not mean that your model is correct. It just says that your model is one of the possible models explaining the relationships behind variables.
